title: Code view
summary: A read-only, line-numbered listing for code or any text: numbers in a sticky gutter that a selection or a copy leaves out, optional highlighted lines, per-line coloured segments, and horizontal scrolling. Give it the lines as a property or as its text content.

props.name: lines
props.description: The lines to show, an array of strings. When empty the element's text content is used instead.

props.name: segments
props.description: Optional colouring: an array parallel to lines, each entry an array of { text, kind, match, word }. kind is a syntax kind (keyword, string, comment, number, type, tag, attribute, directive, key or plain); match and word mark a search hit and the selected word. The segments of a line should join to the line's text.

props.name: start
props.description: The number of the first line, for showing a slice of a longer file.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Line numbers to highlight, such as 12 or 3, 5-7. The first one is scrolled to the middle of the view.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Cap the height, any CSS length. Without it the view is as tall as its lines, or fills a flex parent.

events.name: pk-line-click
events.description: A click left a caret in a line's code (not a drag selection): the line number and the zero-based column of the caret. Not cancelable.

cssProperties.name: --pk-code-view-max-height
cssProperties.description: Maximum body height; set by maxHeight.

cssProperties.name: --pk-code-view-gutter
cssProperties.description: Line-number width in characters; set by the element.

methods.name: parseLines(spec)
methods.description: The set of line numbers a highlight string names.

a11y: The body is a labelled, focusable region so a keyboard can scroll it. Line numbers are generated content: they are not selectable, not copied and not read as part of the code. A highlighted line is marked by a background and a leading edge, not by colour alone in the number. Lines are set as text, never parsed as HTML.

examples.title: Highlighted lines
examples.html:
<pk-code-view label="order.js" highlight="2-3">function total(items) {
    const sum = items.reduce((a, i) => a + i.qty, 0);
    return sum;
}</pk-code-view>

examples.title: A slice starting at line 120, height capped
examples.html:
<pk-code-view label="log.txt" start="120" max-height="6rem">first line of the slice
second line
third line
fourth line
fifth line
sixth line
seventh line</pk-code-view>

examples.title: Long lines scroll sideways
examples.html:
<pk-code-view label="long.txt">const message = 'This line is far longer than the box so it scrolls horizontally instead of wrapping, and the numbers stay put.';
short</pk-code-view>
